en: I'm Brawly! Dewford's Gym Leader. I've been riding the big waves out there, and they've made me tough.
Training in the dark sharpens every sense. Let's see if you can keep your head above water. Here I come!
Whoa, you knocked me right off my board! You've got some real power.
Here, this is the Knuckle Badge. You've earned it, no question.
{player} received the Knuckle Badge from Brawly!
With the Knuckle Badge, your Pokémon can use Flash outside of battle to light up dark places.
You've got a PokéNav? Let's swap numbers. I'll let you know when the surf's up!
Take this too. It's a move I swear by.
TM08 holds Bulk Up. It pumps up your Pokémon's Attack and Defense at the same time.
There's a whole sea of trainers out there. Ride every wave you can!
I'm going to get back out on the water and train harder. Next time, I won't wipe out so easily!
Hey, rookie! It's dark in here, isn't it? Every trainer you beat makes the hall a little brighter.
Brawly's Pokémon are Fighting types. Flying and Psychic moves will hit them hard!
You beat Brawly! Now the whole hall's lit up. That was some battle!
